These are unmodified `smolvm` launcher files from the official
[1.20.2 Linux x86_64 archive](https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/releases/download/v1.20.2/smolvm-1.20.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz)
and [1.22.0 Linux x86_64 archive](https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/releases/download/v1.22.0/smolvm-1.22.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz).
They are test data and are never executed. The upstream
[Apache 2.0 license](../../openapi/LICENSE.smolvm) applies.

All Linux x86_64 and macOS ARM64 archives for the eight versions in
`SmolBox.CI.Runtime` were checked against their official `checksums.sha256`.
The launcher is identical across both platforms for each version:

- 1.22.0: `b67b25f363403e19deceb6897e5a4d94be30a079f8cb751372782f17fc99003a`
- 1.14.1, 1.14.6, 1.16.0, 1.16.1, 1.17.0, 1.19.0, 1.20.2:
  `8caeb3b6e7d834493a578b0fe8bd1e7aa02e68fba6d61bcf70fdbec41a27ce68`
